results.title: GCC General Secretariat announces rescheduling of GCC-EU Summit
results.description: RIYADH, 16th October, 2026 (WAM) -- Jasem Mohamed Albudaiwi, Secretary-General of the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC), announced the rescheduling of the GCC-EU Summit, which was scheduled to be held in Riyadh on 24th October 2026, to a later date to be agreed upon by the GCC and European sides.
